…t one click, the same committente re-photographed

- The PUT's heading rides back with its title: «Completo» shows when the save
  answers, never after a read that took 5 s on a busy backend.
- The list under the field closes at the click, not at the press: closed on the
  press, everything below moved up and the release missed «Annulla» (and «Salva
  e scarica» in the PDF dialog). A blur from the keyboard still closes it at once.
- Picking the linked committente again photographs its heading anew, so what its
  card gained since the link (an amministratore) reaches the PDF.
